note: Battlekit profiles from the Trench Crusade Digital Rulebook 1.0.2 and Warbands of Trench Crusade, under our display names. Prices are in each faction list.

rule.summary: +1 DICE to the model’s Melee Characteristic.
The wielder gains 1 BLOOD MARKER when its Melee Attack is a Success or Critical Success.
Each Shoot ACTION picks Bursts (this profile) or Full Auto: AUTOMATIC 5, HEAVY, RELOAD, RISKY, +1 INJURY DICE.
When it makes 2 Ranged Attacks, both must target the same enemy model.
Special rules: Privileged Access.
Special rules: Spirit of the Beast.
Enemy INFILTRATORS cannot deploy within 16 inches of this model outside their own deployment zone.
Once per game, a failed Risky Success Roll does not end the Activation.
Built into the walker; cannot be removed or lost.
Special rules: Continuous Litany of Prayers, Speak a Blessing ACTION.
Special rules: Insect Wings, Sucked Dry.
Built into the walker; cannot be removed or lost.
Special rules: Drink from the Cup.
Special rules: Gruesome Weight.
Special rules: Inspiring Gift.
When the model goes Out of Action, every enemy within 1 inch gains 1 BLOOD MARKER (not NEGATE FIRE models).
Special rules: Deadly Light.
-1 INJURY DICE against SHRAPNEL hits, even with IGNORE ARMOUR.
Special rules: Battlefield Surgery.
Deployed in its zone; each Field Shrine counts as 3 extra standing models for Morale (up to 9). Removed if hit by an attack or a blast.
Its +1 DICE does not apply when used as an off-hand weapon.
Cloud of Gas: instead of a Ranged Attack, every other model within 6" is hit (friend or foe, no Line of Sight needed) and takes an Injury Roll; no Success Roll.
Walker battlekit; cannot be removed or lost.
Enemies within 1" cannot make Melee Attacks when it retreats; it can Move or Charge while within 1" of enemies.
Special rules: Rally to the Flag.
In a campaign it can be promoted to ELITE in the Promotions & Experience Step.
+1 INJURY DICE for its Ranged Attacks at Short Range.
On a Dash ACTION it may add +2 DICE to the Risky roll; if so it gets 1 BLOOD MARKER.
Special rules: Spirit of Vengeance.
Taken at deployment: NEGATE FEAR for the game and -1 INJURY DICE to attacks that hit the model.
+1 DICE to Success Rolls for ACTIONS that remove BLOOD or INFECTION MARKERS.
Special rules: Blow Thy Horn ACTION.
A Critical Success gives the Injury Roll IGNORE ARMOUR.
Special rules: Lead to Death, Weight of Sins.
Special rules: Famous Deeds.
Base becomes 40mm (unless larger); no Trench Shield; Charge Bonus D3"; a Down result counts as a Minor Hit.

Trigger ACTION, once: Injury Roll for every model within 3" (friend or foe, itself included); its own roll is 4D6 added together; +1 INJURY DICE for others within 1". A survivor needs a new one (35 ducats) or fights without.
Special rules: Enhanced Bullets.
Treat ACTION (Risky): remove 1 BLOOD MARKER from itself or a friend within 1 inch, or stand up a friend within 1 inch.
Has IGNORE ARMOUR against a target that is Down.
Special rules: Brazen Bull Grand Cannon, Unstoppable Object.
A Critical Success gives the Injury Roll IGNORE ARMOUR.
+1 DICE to Risky Success Rolls to climb a sheer surface.
+1 DICE to Dash Risky Success Rolls for friends within 4 inches.
Special rules: Luck of the Devil.
Grind to Dust ACTION: a Melee Attack without a weapon against a Down enemy within 1" on a base of 32mm or smaller.
A failed Risky Success Roll does not end the bearer’s Activation.
Overcharge: a STRONG model, or one touching a friend, may give the attack BLAST 3" and RELOAD; afterwards it gets 1 BLOOD MARKER and its Activation ends.
Special rules: Brought to Heel.
Special rules: Holy Machine.
Special rules: Disposable Rocket.
+1 DICE to its Ranged Characteristic.
When deployed it may be sacrificed: the first BLOOD MARKER placed on the model is ignored.
Special rules: Helpful Servitor.
Can be used for a Ranged Attack once per game.
Ignores the shield’s -INJURY DICE or -INJURY MODIFIERS.
Starting on Open ground it has COVER until it moves; can be used as a 2-handed melee weapon.
+1 DICE if the attacker touches a terrain piece at least half an inch tall that lies between it and the target.
Special rules: Swathed in Smoke.
A Critical Success gives the Injury Roll IGNORE ARMOUR.
Special rules: Enhanced Accuracy.
The model may take two Shoot ACTIONS in one Activation if both use this weapon.
Special rules: Devouring Swarm.
Special rules: Many-Legged Form.
Gains 1 BLESSING MARKER each time a friendly ACTION removes BLOOD or INFECTION MARKERS from friendly models.
Against an armoured or shielded target (or Armour -1 or better), one die of the roll counts as a 6. Not affected by the Dragonslayer Patron skill.
Special rules: Goetic Secrets.
Special rules: Retribution.
Special rules: Dragged Forwards, Deadly Embrace.
Special rules: Loyal Hound, The Dogs of War, Special Training, Guard Dog, Hellhound, Martyrdom Dog, Mercy Dog, Pack Loyalty, Teeth and Claws.
Range 6"-36" (the book prints IGNORES COVER, read as IGNORE COVER): the target (model or point) cannot be within 6" of the firer, though a Scatter may land closer.
Once per game, a failed Risky Success Roll does not end the Activation.
Special rules: Myrmidon Wings, Steadfast.
Special rules: Mark of the Pit.
An enemy without FEAR that starts its Activation within 1" must Retreat, and cannot take ACTIONS needing a Risky roll while within 1".
Taken at deployment: NEGATE FEAR for the game and -1 INJURY DICE to attacks that hit the model.
